title: Understanding the Vectors
text: The vectors $$u_1$$ and $$u_2$$ are columns of a matrix U. They are orthogonal unit vectors, meaning they are perpendicular to each other and have a magnitude of $$1$$.

title: Checking Orthogonality
text: To check if $$u_1$$ and $$u_2$$ are orthogonal, calculate their dot product. If the dot product is zero, they are orthogonal.

title: Calculate the Dot Product
text: Calculate the dot product of $$u_1$$ and $$u_2$$: $$0.8\times0.6+\left(-0.6\times0.8\right)+0\times0+0\times0+0\times0+0\times0$$. What is the result?

title: Magnitude of Vectors
text: The magnitude of a vector u is calculated as $$\sqrt{{u_1}^2+{u_2}^2+{u_3}^2+{u_4}^2+{u_5}^2+{u_6}^2}$$. Check if both $$u_1$$ and $$u_2$$ have a magnitude of $$1$$.

title: Calculate Magnitude of $$u_1$$
text: Calculate the magnitude of $$u_1$$: $$\sqrt{{0.8}^2+{\left(-0.6\right)}^2+0^2+0^2+0^2+0^2}$$. What is the result?

title: Calculate Magnitude of $$u_2$$
text: Calculate the magnitude of $$u_2$$: $$\sqrt{{0.6}^2+{0.8}^2+0^2+0^2+0^2+0^2}$$. What is the result?

title: Conclusion
text: Since the dot product of $$u_1$$ and $$u_2$$ is zero and both vectors have a magnitude of $$1$$, they are valid orthogonal unit vectors.
